XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Front windshield wiper and washer inactive; rear wipers operating smoothly
XDOCUMENTO.InfoDoc: ELECTRONICS | AIRBAG | B1008 | B101B | SWITCH | LIGHTS | LIGHT SWITCH | ON | ON | RED | WORKING | INACTIVE | BUZZER | SIGNAL | CONTACT | ROTATING |

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Airbag

  • Device: Rotary switch

  • Fault: Airbag warning light illuminated (red), with occasional failure of the audible warning signal

  • Errors detected by self-diagnosis:
  • B1008 (Driver airbag resistor, 1st level – Fault)
  • B101B (Driver airbag resistor, 2nd level – Fault)
  • Cause: Faulty rotary switch

• Action: Check that the rotary contact is working correctly and, if necessary, replace it

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: The rotary switch is incorporated into the light switch and, following its replacement, the fault was permanently resolved without the need for any reprogramming using diagnostic equipment.

    The estimated time for the repair is approximately 1.7 hours.
